observations: Photo 0: a white front-loading washing machine with 'LG' and 'INVERTER DirectDrive 7kg' printed on the control panel; a small model code under the badge looks like F1068QDP2 but is not crisp.
Program dial, buttons and a small digital display panel present; display is off, no power-on shown.
DD Motor 10 year warranty sticker and an LG 'Less Noise, Less Vibration, More Durability' sticker on the door panel.
Visible rust along the top edge of the front panel under the control fascia and along the bottom kick plate seam; general dirt and stains on the cabinet.
Door, gasket and filter cover appear present; machine stands on a bare concrete floor outdoors; no rear, hoses or plug shown.

identity.model: Inverter DirectDrive 7kg front loader (code reads about F1068QDP2)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 control panel reads LG INVERTER DirectDrive 7kg.
Photo 0 shows rust on the front panel top and bottom edges and a dirty, stained cabinet.
Internal history cannot be seen in photos.
No clip of it powering on, filling, washing or spinning.
No receipt or warranty card shown; at this age a warranty is unlikely to be in force.
Nothing in the photo shows the location.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on, fill, drain or spin; control board or drain pump faults are common
risks.proof: Clip of a full cycle start: power on, water filling, drum turning, then a spin, with a handwritten code in shot

risks.risk: Drum bearing wear or a leaking door gasket
risks.proof: Clip of the empty drum spun by hand and a close photo of the door gasket folds

risks.risk: Rust may extend to the base and inner cabinet
risks.proof: Photos of the sides, rear and underside of the cabinet
risks.if_unproven: as rusted body, fair to poor condition

risks.risk: Inlet and drain hoses or power cord missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the back showing hoses and the power cord

proof_requests: Clip of the machine powered on, filling and spinning with a handwritten code in shot
Photo of the rear rating label with model and serial
Photos of the sides, rear and underside showing rust extent
Close photo of the door gasket and drum
response.reason: LG Inverter DirectDrive 7kg is read on the control panel in photo 0, so it is priced at its worst case as a rusted used front loader not working until a running clip is shown; the like new claim is contradicted by visible rust.
